mentions.name: Formal Verification Programming Language Evals
mentions.description: Benchmark evals that measure AI coding performance in programming languages with formal verification, aiming to gauge how far models are from good coding performance in less popular languages and account for the quirks formal verification adds.
mentions.problem: It is unclear how far AI models are from good coding performance in less popular languages in general, and formal verification adds quirks on top of that.
mentions.source_excerpt: Evals for programming languages with formal verification. It's not clear how far we are from good coding performance in less popular languages in general, and formal verification has some quirks on top also.

evidence.value: Evals for programming languages with formal verification. It's not clear how far we are from good coding performance in less popular languages in general, and formal verification has some quirks on top also.
